title: Paginated Report Migration
summary: Move paginated (RDL) reports from Power BI Premium capacity workspaces to Fabric workspaces: inventory, workspace reassignment or RDL republishing, deployment pipeline rules, gateways, validation and cutover.
audience: BI developers, Power BI and Fabric administrators, migration leads

pages.title: Overview
pages.description: What moves, the two migration methods, who can view paginated reports after the move, and a map of the playbook.

pages.title: Phase 1: Inventory and assessment
pages.description: Catalog every report with REST calls and an RDL parser, classify what needs rework, and decide migrate, modify, redesign or retire.

pages.title: Phase 2: Migration methods
pages.description: Reassign a workspace to Fabric capacity, republish RDL files by Report Builder or REST, handle SSRS and Report Server sources, and choose between them.

pages.title: Pipelines, gateways and sources
pages.description: Data source rules in deployment pipelines, gateway and cloud connection mapping, Fabric Warehouse and Lakehouse SQL endpoint sources, and the REST calls that script them.

pages.title: Phase 3: Validation and cutover
pages.description: Parity tests for layout, data and exports, performance and capacity checks, subscriptions and permissions, cutover sequence, rollback and decommissioning.

pages.title: Risks, troubleshooting, checklist
pages.description: Risk register, symptom-to-fix table, a migration readiness checklist and references.
